scope: Actual Migen CRGs including two actual PLL UNISIMs and old/new analog. Compares all49 output bits and SYSclock in two stable locked/reset-released epochs; nominal WRT C source2ns/CLK C source1.5ns verified; pads include vendor UNISIM ODDR propagation, covered by exact new/old49-bit comparison. Unlocked startup outputs are explicitly unqualified. Does not prove analog PVT, jitter, metastability or PCB skew.
